requestedText: Add an immutable Telegram publication receipt and explicit same-snapshot delivery retry for precomputed Weekly Radar facts.

evidence: The receipt service retains an in-memory WeeklyRadarPublication and calls only an injected publisher and clock; it does not load files, resolve providers, or invoke a scheduler.
No runtime Telegram consumer or provider SDK exists in this repository; public coverage uses an in-memory transport and real network behavior is explicitly out of scope.
WR-012 adds typed receipt data only and does not add telemetry, monitoring, polling, webhook, persistence, backoff, or automatic retry behavior.
The Contract authorizes the repository lifecycle while restricting this WI to immutable receipt evidence, provider-neutral IDs, explicit delivery retry, tests, and documentation.
